sn51.22:1.2: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavantam etad avoca || || 3.
sn51.22:1.3: Abhijānāti nu kho bhante Bhagavā iddhiyā manomayena kāyena Brahmalokam upasaṅkamitā ti || ||
sn51.22:1.4: Abhijānāmi khvāham Ānanda iddhiyā manomayena kāyena Brahmalokam upasaṅkamitā ti || || 4.
sn51.22:1.5: Abhijānāti kho pana bhante Bhagavā iminā cātumahābhūtikena kāyena iddhiyā Brahmalokam upasaṅkamitā ti || ||
sn51.22:1.6: Abhijānāmi khavāham Ānanda iminā cātumahābhūtikena kāyena iddhiyā Brahmalokam upasaṅkamitā ti || || 5. Yaṃ
sn51.22:2.1: ca kho opapāti ha bhante Bhagavā iddhiyā manomayena kāyena Brahmalokam upasaṅkamituṃ || yaṃ ca kho abhijānāti bhante Bhagavā iminā cātumahābhūtikena kāyena iddhiyā Brahmalokam upasaṅkamitā || tayidam bhante Bhagavato acchariyaṃ ceva abbhutaṃ cāti || ||
sn51.22:2.2: Acchariyā ceva Ānanda tathāgatā acchariyadhammasamannāgatā ca abbhutā ceva Ānanda tathagatā abbhutadhammasamannāgatā ca || || 6.
sn51.22:3.1: Yasmiṃ Ānanda samaye Tathāgato kāyam pi citte samādahati cittam pi ca kāye samādahati || sukhasaññañca lahusaññañca kāye okkamitvā viharati ||
sn51.22:3.2: tasmiṃ Ānanda samaye Tathāgatassa kāyo lahutaro ceva hoti mudutaro ca kammaniyataro ca pabhassarataro ca || || 7.
sn51.22:4.1: Seyyathāpi ānanda ayoguḷo divasaṃ santatto lahutaro ceva hoti mudutaro ca kammaniyataro ca pabhassarataro ca ||
sn51.22:4.2: evam eva kho Ānanda yasmiṃ samaye Tathāgato kāyam pi citte samādahati || cittam pi kāye samādahati || sukhasaññañca lahusaññañca kāye okkamitvā viharati ||
sn51.22:4.3: tasmim Ānanda samaye Tathāgatassa kāyo lahutaro ceva hoti mudutaro ca kammaniyataro ca pabhassarataro ca || || 8.
sn51.22:5.1: Yasmim Ānanda samaye Tathāgato kāyam pi citte samādahati || cittam pi kāye samādahati || sukhasaññañca lahusaññañca kāye okkamitvā viharati ||
sn51.22:5.2: tasmim Ānanda samaye Tathāgatassa kāyo appakasireneva pathaviyā vehāsam abbhuggacchati ||
sn51.22:5.3: so anekavihitam iddhividham paccanubhoti || eko pi hutvā bahudhā hoti || pe || la || yāva Brahmalokā pi kāyena vasaṃ vatteti || || 9.
sn51.22:6.1: Seyyathāpi Ānanda tūlapicu vā kappāsapicu vā lahuko vātupādāno appakasireneva pathaviyā vehāsam abbhuggacchati ||
sn51.22:6.2: evam eva kho Ānanda yasmiṃ samaye Tathāgato kāyam pi citte samādahati || cittam pi kāye samādahati || sukhasaññañca lahusaññañca kāye okkamitvā viharati ||
sn51.22:6.3: tasmim Ānanda samaye Tathāgatassa kāyo appakasireneva pathaviyā vehāsam abbhuggacchati ||
sn51.22:6.4: so anekavihitam iddhividham paccanubhoti || eko pi hutvā bahudhā hoti || la || pe || yāva Brahmalokā pi kāyena vasaṃ vattetī ti || || 2.
